newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia may suspend Barcelona-Buenos Aires.
newsitem.headline: Iberia may suspend Barcelona-Buenos Aires.

text.p: Iberia is likely to suspend its weekly 747 freighter service from Barcelona to Buenos Aires at the end of this month, a cargo official at the company said.
The service, which stops in Madrid if there is sufficient demand, started at the end of October.
"The idea was to continue until the end of December. It's not certain that we'll fly in the last week because of the public holidays," the official said.
Iberia's other weekly 747 freighter service to Buenos Aires from Maastricht via Madrid, flown by the same leased aircraft, is a year round operation and will continue.

October to December are the peak months for Spanish air cargo business. Manufactured goods exports usually decline in January and the volume of perishable products slips from March. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax +44-171-542-5017
